Pain point (their words): I built the straddle in Sensibull to check Greeks, but when I sent the basket on Kite, the call filled at 112 and put at 118 when mid was 108. Slipped 14 points instantly. I had no idea what my worst fill was before clicking.
Workaround: Manually places limit orders leg by leg; frequently misses quick fills

Pain point (their words): Last expiry, my short PE leg filled, but the long OTM protection leg hit a freeze quantity error. Suddenly Kite blocked 1.8 Lakhs margin instead of 42k. I panicked because I was naked short on the downside.
Workaround: Calculates margin by hand in Excel before market open; avoids 4-leg baskets on expiry day

Pain point (their words): Sensibull shows max profit and loss nicely on desktop, but on mobile in the final broker confirmation screen, it just shows separate legs. You don't see your net debit or breakeven at that critical split second.
Workaround: Double checks on a desktop notebook before submitting order

Pain point (their words): I bought 24700 CE and 24300 PE thinking it was cheap. I didn't realize the bid-ask spread on the OTM put was 18% wide. I was down ₹1,500 the millisecond it filled.
Workaround: Relies on Finviz or YouTube tips; doesn't know how to inspect order book spread

Pain point (their words): Dhan is fast, but when volatility expands at 2:30 PM, market basket orders slip horribly. There is no pre-trade fill simulator that says 'Hey, at current book depth, your net debit will be ₹38 instead of ₹32'.
Workaround: Uses conservative limit orders with wide tolerances

Pain point (their words): My broker margin calculator said ₹52,000 required. When I fired the basket, Kite executed the short legs first, rejected the long legs due to insufficient cash, and I got a margin shortfall penalty notice.
Workaround: Orders long legs manually 2 minutes before short legs (hedge-first)

Pain point (their words): I sold a put spread thinking my risk was small, but during a sharp market plunge, the broker's auto square-off squared off my long hedge first because of margin recalculation, leaving my short put open.
Workaround: Stopped trading multi-leg spreads on Groww; trades only single calls
